newsitem.title: FRANCE: Abbott takes Genset stake to seal alliance.
newsitem.headline: Abbott takes Genset stake to seal alliance.

text.p: Abbott Laboratories said in a joint statement it would take a $20 million stake in France's Genset to cement a strategic alliance.

Abbott will make a $10 million investment immediately after signing the agreement and another $10 upon exercise of a put-option by Genset during the year following the first anniversary of the investment, if the parties have met certain obligations.
Under an alliance, Abbott and Genset will collaborate in pharmacogenomics by analysing variations in patient responses to drug therapy.

Genset will develop a proprietary high-density bi-allelic marker map of the human genome and will apply its technology platform to identify markets and genes associated with response to the administration of a pharmaceutical compound.
Abbott will develop, produce and market diagnostic systems derived from these genes and markers to clinically test patient responses.
Genset and Abbott will receive research and development fees and, proportional to their technology input, will share revenues on drugs developed using their pharmacogenomics tools.
Genset and Abbott will immediately initiate dialogue with other pharmaceutical companies with the goal to rapidly structure several similar projects.
Abbott earlier this year bought the Alcyon Analyzer SA maker of clinical chemistry analyzers and also sold some businesses from Sanofi.
